clue.text: Top player growing old captures pawn – a quick way to check mate

definitions.text: a quick way to check mate

indicators.note: to capture is to take and hold inside, so one piece is put within another

blocks.note: a seeded player in a tournament is one of the top-ranked
P is the chess notation for a pawn
something that is dating is becoming old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A chess game in which a veteran grandmaster takes a pawn on the way to checkmate.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess words 'pawn' and 'check mate' set up a board game, but 'mate' here is a romantic partner and 'check' means assess.
explanation.definitionFit: Speed dating lets singles meet many potential partners in brief timed conversations, a fast method of sizing up a possible romantic match.

clue.text: Direct Argentine leader once imprisoning male drunkards

indicators.note: imprisoning means holding something locked inside, so the leader's name surrounds the rest

blocks.note: Juan Perón was president of Argentina
a son is a male child
a toper is a habitual heavy drinker

explanation.surface: A former Argentine president locks up a man and some drunks.
explanation.definitionFit: A person-to-person exchange happens directly between two individuals, without any intermediary, so the phrase works as an adjective meaning straight.

clue.text: Buried by squirrel, a nut in style

indicators.note: something buried lies concealed within, so the letters sit inside the neighbouring words

blocks.note: the letters run across the end of squirrel, then a, then the start of nut

explanation.surface: A squirrel hides a nut with some panache.
explanation.definitionFit: Élan is dash, flair or a stylish confidence of manner, a borrowing from French.

clue.text: Repetitive exercise? Hint this is something boring

blocks.note: a drill is a practice routine repeated over and over
a bit is a small amount, a hint of something

explanation.surface: A question about a tedious exercise followed by the remark that it is dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' reads as tedious, but the definition means something that bores holes.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill bit is the cutting tool fitted to a drill that bores holes, so it literally does boring work.

clue.text: Holiday destination with similar ideas?

definitions.note: read as THE MED, two words

blocks.note: first meaning: the Mediterranean, a popular holiday area, split as two words
second meaning: built around a common subject

explanation.walkthrough: THE MED is the everyday British name for the Mediterranean as a holiday area; run together it is one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something themed is organised around one unifying subject, so all its parts share related concepts.

clue.text: French city – worth a visit?

blocks.note: first meaning: the resort on the Riviera
second meaning: pleasant, agreeable

explanation.surface: A travel tip asking whether a certain French city is worth going to.
explanation.definitionFit: The Riviera resort shares its spelling with the English adjective for pleasant, which is what a place worth visiting is.

clue.text: Downer in loss of position?

definitions.note: read as DIS-APPOINTMENT, an undoing of an appointment

blocks.note: first meaning: a letdown, something depressing
second meaning, split DIS plus APPOINTMENT: being removed from a post

explanation.surface: Someone feeling low after being demoted.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is whimsical: DIS- undoes, and an appointment is a position.
explanation.definitionFit: A downer is a depressing experience or letdown, which is exactly what a failed hope brings.

clue.text: Dancing seen with certain celebratory occasions

indicators.note: dancing letters move about and settle in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Dancing is spotted at particular festive events.
explanation.definitionFit: Centenaries are hundredth anniversaries, which are marked with celebrations.

clue.text: Mafia activity for example decreasing, or I'm worried!

indicators.note: to worry something is to tug and shake it about, so the letters are disturbed

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone hopes gangster activity is falling, or else they are anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For example' belongs to the definition: Mafia activity is one instance of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mafia is the classic criminal syndicate, so its work is a prime instance of crime run by structured gangs.

clue.text: Song name in short service for singer

indicators.note: short means cut off before its end, so the last letter goes
in places the first pieces inside the service word

blocks.note: an aria is a solo song in an opera
to call someone something is to name them
Mass is a church service

explanation.surface: A hymn with a name sung during a brief church service by a vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: MASS loses its last S to become MAS, which then holds ARIA plus CALL.
explanation.definitionFit: Maria Callas was a celebrated Greek-American operatic soprano of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Unsigned, church official forgetting initial

indicators.note: forgetting the initial means leaving out the opening letter

blocks.note: a canon is a member of a cathedral's clergy

explanation.surface: A cleric who forgot to sign their name.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is short for anonymous, the attribution given to a work whose author is unknown.

clue.text: Group of taxis measures about fifty

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round the other

blocks.note: feet are units of length
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A taxi company's vehicles run to about fifty in number.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleet is a set of vehicles run by one operator, such as a cab firm.

clue.text: Remain with auditor's burden?

indicators.note: an auditor is a listener, so the word is taken as heard

blocks.note: a weight is a load to carry

explanation.surface: An accountant stays on, saddled with a heavy load.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Auditor' suggests an accountant, but here it means a listener.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay put until something happens is to hang on, i.e. stay where you are.

clue.text: Wolf down in well, consequential

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

blocks.note: to wolf food is to eat it greedily
well and my are both exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: Gobbling food down a well, which matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaty describes something substantial, with plenty of weighty content to it.

clue.text: Be loud, quiet somewhere else?

blocks.note: sh is the instruction to hush
someone out is away, not at home

explanation.surface: A contradictory instruction to be noisy, or silent elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To yell is to raise the voice, the most obvious way of making a lot of noise.

clue.text: Up on the horizon

blocks.note: first meaning: aloft, above the ground
second meaning: about to happen, being talked of

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means literally airborne and figuratively impending, as in change being sensed around us.

clue.text: Edit out groovy old maestro

blocks.note: to chop material is to cut it from a text
in means fashionable, as does groovy

explanation.surface: An editor cuts out a hip old conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: Frédéric Chopin was the nineteenth-century Polish composer and piano virtuoso.

clue.text: Just deserts left, concrete surrounds

indicators.note: surrounds means goes round, so the second word encloses the first

blocks.note: to have quit is to have left
concrete means actual, tangible

explanation.surface: Fair punishment for walking out, with concrete all around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Concrete' looks like building material but means tangible.
explanation.definitionFit: Requital is repayment, the getting back of what one deserves, for good or ill.

clue.text: US author back in the top academy

indicators.note: in says the letters are found inside the following words
back means read from right to left

blocks.note: the letters straddle the end of the, all of top and the start of academy

explanation.surface: An American writer returns to teach at the leading college.
explanation.definitionFit: Truman Capote was the American writer of In Cold Blood and Breakfast at Tiffany's.

clue.text: Half of rudd and plaice cooked – fishy!

indicators.note: half of means keep just the first two of the four letters
cooked food is mixed and changed, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the front half of the fish's name
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dish of rudd and plaice that tastes rather off.
explanation.walkthrough: Rudd is a freshwater fish. 'Fishy' looks like a comment on the cooking but means suspicious.
explanation.definitionFit: Fishy is informal for suspicious or odd, and something strange or questionable is just that.

clue.text: Zoom business

blocks.note: first meaning: rush along at speed
second meaning: one's profession or line of work

explanation.walkthrough: Zoom suggests the video-call company, a business, but the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to hurtle headlong, and as a noun one's lifelong occupation.

clue.text: Bit of fun in flier?

blocks.note: first meaning: a prank or jolly escapade
second meaning: a songbird

explanation.surface: Some amusement on board an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a piece of mischief and a small singing bird, a creature that takes to the air.

clue.text: Article dipped in gravy for god

indicators.note: dipped in means plunged inside, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: jus is a thin meat juice served as gravy
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece gets dunked in gravy as an offering to a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Janus was the two-faced Roman deity of doorways and beginnings.

clue.text: Infection you observed by the way

indicators.note: observed by means seen next to, so one piece sits beside the other

blocks.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
ye is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: An infection someone noticed along the road, as an aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By the way' reads as an aside, but 'by' joins 'observed' and 'the way' is the street.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed infected swelling on the edge of the eyelid.

clue.text: After British, one Greek letter – and another!

indicators.note: after says the second piece follows the first

blocks.note: B is the abbreviation for British
eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone reciting the Greek alphabet adds one letter after another.
explanation.walkthrough: Building one Greek letter produces a second one, hence the exclamation mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta is the second character of the Greek alphabet, so it is a further such character.

clue.text: Stink in second half of game?

indicators.note: the second half means keep only the latter portion of the name

blocks.note: the game meant is table tennis under its informal reduplicated name; keep the back half

explanation.surface: A bad smell in the second half of a match.
explanation.walkthrough: A pong is British slang for a bad smell.
explanation.definitionFit: Pong is informal British for a strong unpleasant smell, a stench.

clue.text: Previously described, suggestion of a number?

indicators.note: a suggestion of a number is that number merely spoken of, so sound it out

blocks.note: taken as written
four is a number
a number suggested is a number brought up in talk

explanation.surface: Something said earlier hints at a particular figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay reads as 'a four mentioned', which sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Aforementioned means referred to earlier in the text, said before.

clue.text: More than one staircase inspires cheerful, brilliant decorator?

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so one word takes another inside

blocks.note: a flight is a set of stairs
airy means light-hearted

explanation.surface: A cheerful interior designer is inspired by several staircases.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decorator' suggests a painter, but here it means something that decorates.
explanation.definitionFit: Strings of small coloured bulbs adorn Christmas trees and gardens, shining ornaments that dress a room.
